div.div:
مُتَقَوِّسٌ (assumed tropical:) An eyebrow [or other thing] likened to a bow; as also ↓ مُسْتَقْوِسٌ (K) and ↓ مُقَوَّسٌ : (TA:) ↓ the second of these epithets is also applied, in the same sense, or like a bow, to a gutter round a tent, and the like. (TA.) ―
-b2- Also, A man bowed, or bent; and so ↓ مُقَوِّسٌ . (TA.) ＝
-A2- Also, (K,) or مُتَقَوِّسٌ قَوْسَهُ, (S,) A man having with him his bow. (S, K. *)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
